data.action: 白手套手指抵太阳穴施展心理掌握，星瞳狡黠，从容微笑
data.camera: medium shot, elegant gesture, school courtyard, queenly poise
data.description: 【常盘台中庭·午后】女王蜂缓缓抬起雪白的手套手指，轻轻抵在太阳穴旁——那是最优雅的支配手势。星形的瞳孔里闪过狡黠的光，常盘台的中庭在她的一次眨眼间秩序井然。米色毛衣背心与灰裙勾勒出从容的仪态，手提包里的遥控器排成一列，仿佛整个学园都是她的舞台——「心理掌握，全员听我指挥哦♪」
data.lighting: 明亮校园阳光与中庭绿荫
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki touches a spider-web-printed glove to her temple in the Mental Out gesture, star pupils glinting above a composed smile. Beige vest, white short-sleeved shirt and grey pleated skirt retain her Tokiwadai uniform, remote-filled handbag on her other arm. The medium view places orderly courtyard paths beneath trees behind her. Clear campus sunlight illuminates the glove and remote edges, balanced by green reflected shade along her blonde hair and collar.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 心理掌握的女王仪态·「全员——听我指挥哦♪」
